result.instructions: Tools for Textline, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Textline data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run textline_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run textline_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run textline_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. textline_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: textline_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations (one per contact) in a department of the Textline shared inbox, with the contact and resolved status. Optional keyword search. GET /api/conversations.json.

group_uuid.description: Department (group) UUID from textline_list_departments. Default: the first department.

query.description: Keyword to search conversations on (name, phone, message text).

tools.name: textline_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation messages
tools.description: Retrieve one conversation and its posts (messages in and out, internal whispers, resolve/transfer events), newest page first. Page with page/page_size or with before_uuid/after_uuid (a post uuid). GET /api/conversation/{uuid}.json.

before_uuid.description: Only posts before this post uuid (exclusive).

after_uuid.description: Only posts after this post uuid (exclusive).

tools.name: textline_get_conversation_by_phone
tools.title: Get conversation by phone number
tools.description: Retrieve the conversation with a phone number (in a department) and its posts (messages). GET /api/conversations.json?phone_number=….

phone_number.description: The contact's phone number, e.g. +14155550123 or (415) 555-0123.

group_uuid.description: Department (group) UUID from textline_list_departments. Default: the first department.

before_uuid.description: Only posts before this post uuid (exclusive).

after_uuid.description: Only posts after this post uuid (exclusive).

tools.name: textline_list_customers
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (customers) in the Textline address book: name, phone, email, tags, notes, custom fields, consent and reachability. GET /api/customers.json.

query.description: Keyword to search on (name, phone, email, tag).

tools.name: textline_get_customer
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Retrieve one contact (customer) from the address book by UUID. GET /api/customer/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: textline_get_customer_by_phone
tools.title: Get contact by phone number
tools.description: Retrieve one contact (customer) from the address book by phone number. GET /api/customers.json?phone_number=….

tools.name: textline_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List contact custom fields
tools.description: List the address book's custom fields (name, data type, UUID). Use the UUIDs with textline_update_customer. GET /api/address_book/custom_fields.json.

tools.name: textline_list_saved_searches
tools.title: List saved searches
tools.description: List the address book's saved searches (contact segments) with name, description and UUID. GET /api/address_book/saved_searches.json.

tools.name: textline_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Retrieve the organization (account) name, optionally with its departments and agents. GET /api/organization.json.

tools.name: textline_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the departments (groups / inbox phone lines) the token's agent can see: name, UUID, phone number, type (sms, facebook, smart_sms) and member agent UUIDs. GET /api/groups.json.

tools.name: textline_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List the agents (users) in the organization: name, email, UUID, permission level, availability and department UUIDs. GET /api/organization.json?include_users=1.

tools.name: textline_get_agent
tools.title: Get agent
tools.description: Retrieve one agent (user) by UUID or email: name, permission level, availability (on_call) and departments. GET /api/users.json.

tools.name: textline_list_dispositions
tools.title: List dispositions
tools.description: List the dispositions (resolution reasons) set up in the account, optionally for one department. Use a UUID with textline_resolve_conversation. GET /api/dispositions.json.

tools.name: textline_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: List surveys (NPS, CSAT, custom) with their type and UUID. GET /api/surveys.json.

tools.name: textline_list_survey_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List the responses to one survey (ratings, follow-up text, contact, tags). Default: the last 30 days. GET /api/survey/{uuid}/responses.json.

tools.name: textline_report_conversations
tools.title: Report conversations by date
tools.description: Reporting API: list a department's conversations filtered by created/updated time, resolved, archived or blocked, with total_records. To get the next page pass the returned next.search_uuid, next.page and next.page_size exactly (the same filters are kept). Then use textline_report_posts per conversation. GET /api/reporting/conversations.json.

group_uuid.description: Department UUID (required unless search_uuid is given).

search_uuid.description: Continue an earlier result set: next.search_uuid from a previous call (with next.page and next.page_size).

created_after.description: Created after this ISO date-time (with timezone).

created_before.description: Created before this ISO date-time (with timezone).

updated_after.description: Updated after this ISO date-time (with timezone).

updated_before.description: Updated before this ISO date-time (with timezone).

archived.description: Only archived (true) or unarchived (false) contacts. Default: both.

blocked.description: Only blocked (true) or unblocked (false) contacts. Default: both.

tools.name: textline_report_posts
tools.title: Report posts of a conversation
tools.description: Reporting API: list all posts (messages, whispers) of one conversation with creator, thread, first-response flags, filtered by created time, with total_records. To get the next page pass the returned next.search_uuid, next.page and next.page_size exactly. GET /api/reporting/conversation/{uuid}/posts.json.

search_uuid.description: Continue an earlier result set: next.search_uuid from a previous call (with next.page and next.page_size).

created_after.description: Created after this ISO date-time (with timezone).

created_before.description: Created before this ISO date-time (with timezone).

tools.name: textline_send_message
tools.title: Send SMS message
tools.description: SENDS A REAL SMS/MMS to ONE contact from your Textline number — the customer receives it immediately and it cannot be unsent; it consumes message credits. Address it by conversation_uuid or by phone_number (+ optional department). Confirm the recipient and text with the user first. One recipient per call; no bulk sends. POST /api/conversation/{uuid}.json or POST /api/conversations.json.

conversation_uuid.description: The conversation UUID (pass this OR phone_number).

phone_number.description: The contact's phone number (pass this OR conversation_uuid); opens the conversation if there is none.

group_uuid.description: With phone_number only: the department to use. Default: the first department.

body.description: The message text the customer will receive.

attachment_urls.description: Public https URLs of files to attach (makes it an MMS).

tools.name: textline_add_whisper
tools.title: Add internal note (whisper)
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal whisper (a note only your agents see, never sent to the customer) to a conversation, by conversation_uuid or phone_number. POST /api/conversation/{uuid}.json or POST /api/conversations.json with a whisper.

conversation_uuid.description: The conversation UUID (pass this OR phone_number).

phone_number.description: The contact's phone number (pass this OR conversation_uuid); opens the conversation if there is none.

group_uuid.description: With phone_number only: the department to use. Default: the first department.

body.description: The note text (visible to agents only).

resolve.description: Resolve the conversation after adding the note.

tools.name: textline_resolve_conversation
tools.title: Resolve conversation
tools.description: WRITE: mark a conversation resolved (closed), optionally with a disposition from textline_list_dispositions. Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /api/conversation/{uuid}/resolve.json.

tools.name: textline_transfer_conversation
tools.title: Transfer conversation
tools.description: WRITE: assign a conversation to another agent of the same department, by agent UUID or email (one of them). Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /api/conversation/{uuid}/transfer.json.

tools.name: textline_create_customer
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (customer) to the Textline address book. Sends nothing to the contact. POST /api/customers.json.

notes.description: Notes on the contact (replaces the existing notes).

tools.name: textline_update_customer
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: update a contact's name, email, notes, tags (add, remove or replace) or custom fields (by custom-field UUID from textline_list_custom_fields). Overwrites the fields you pass; sends nothing to the contact. PUT /api/customer/{uuid}.json.

notes.description: Notes on the contact (replaces the existing notes).

tags_handling.description: How to apply tags: add, remove or replace (Textline's default if omitted).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom-field UUID, e.g. {"c43a1766-47e1-4c9c-a2cc-36bf424fcbc0": "Gold"}.
